The [[Spectral Essence]] is a [[bundle]] found initially in the Southern Shiverpeaks and is dropped upon the death of an [[Eidolon]] or the [[Ice Beast]] for [[armor]] [[infusion]] upon delivery to the [[Ancient Seer|Seer]]. It is also encountered during two of the missions in the [[Ring of Fire Islands]] while completing the bonuses.

***Eidolon

== Notes ==
*The entire armor set is infused upon delivery of the spectral essence. Make sure to wear the armor pieces you want to infuse before talking to the Seer.

==Trivia==
* Originally, infusion required one Spectral Essence for each piece of armor.
{{Anomaly|The model of this bundle when it is on the ground hovers above the ground instead being directly touching it like other bundles.}}
